App details

Age & Date Toolkit

Find exact ages, compare dates and count down to birthdays and anniversaries.

In the worksPlannedAndroid

What it’s for

Calculate exact age, date differences and time until the next birthday or anniversary; add or subtract calendar periods from dates. Designed for offline use.

Main features

  • Age in years, months and days.
  • Add or subtract years, months, weeks and days.
  • Save named dates and copy results.
  • Calculations work offline.

This app is planned. The description presents documented plans, not an app available to download. The final design and app still need approval and testing; there is no announced release date.

How to use

Enter a birth date and a reference date to see age in years, months and days. Compare two dates, or add and subtract calendar periods to plan a deadline. Save a date with a name to revisit a birthday or anniversary, and copy the result.

Important limits

Calendar months have different lengths, so a month is not treated as thirty days. No country holiday calendar, time-zone conversion or reminder notification is planned for the first version.

Offline use, permissions and purchases

The planned core functions run on the device without a JN86 account. Advertising, purchases, optional downloads and external links may need an internet connection. Offline core operation does not rule out separate service data flows.

Android 7.0 or newer is the common planned baseline. Individual sensor and platform features still depend on the device.

Permissions

The planned date tools need no camera, microphone, location or contacts access. Advertising and Play purchasing may use separate network services.

Local data

Saved names and dates and display settings are intended to stay locally. Date calculations need no account and are not sent to a JN86 server.

Advertising and purchases

The plan keeps every core feature free, with banner advertising and an optional one-time Google Play purchase to remove ads. There is no subscription. Actual local prices will come from Play; advertising providers, consent choices and SDK data handling must be specified before launch.

First version and later ideas

The functions above belong to the documented plan for the first version. Features mentioned below as excluded or later ideas are not promised as current capabilities.

Calendar sync, export and automatic reminders are outside the first version.

Availability

This app is being created. The features described here are planned; it is not yet available to download.
